relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: He had a brilliant educational career in the D. A. V. College, Lahore, from where he graduated

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: He continued his studies in the Oriental College, Lahore, from which institution he took the M.A. degree of the Panjab University in 1900

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: He started life as Professor of Sanskrit and Philosophy in his own College (the D. A. V. College)

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: was the Reader in Sanskrit at the Panjab University, teaching Sanskrit and Comparative Philology to the M.A. classes.

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: Later in 1928, when he was the Government Epigraphist for India, his University again honoured him by conferring on him the degree of Doctor of Literature

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: He joined the Archæological Survey of India in 1903 as Assistant Archæological Surveyor, Northern Circle.

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: In 1906 he was made Archæological Assistant, Librarian and Curator of the Government Museum at Nagpur.

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: Subsequently, in 1913, he became the Curator of the Provincial Museum at Lucknow.

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: In 1917 he was sent on deputation to the Jammu and Kashmir State as Superintendent of Archæology.

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: in 1925, on the retirement of Rao Bahadur H. Krishna Sastri, became the Government Epigraphist for India.

relations.subject: Hirananda Sastri
relations.evidence: he was appointed in the Baroda State as Director of Archæology in November 1934. He held that post till 1942

relations.subject: C. R. Krishnamacharlu
relations.evidence: joined the Christian College at Madras for his collegiate courses. Having finished his F. A. in that College

relations.subject: C. R. Krishnamacharlu
relations.evidence: he took his University degree from the Pachchayappa's College, Madras

relations.subject: C. R. Krishnamacharlu
relations.evidence: He took his early training in the field of epigraphy and worked in close collaboration with the late Rao Bahadur H. Krishna Sastri.

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: He studied in Christiania under Sophus Bugge and took a Degree in 1891 in Classics and German Philology.

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: For some time he was a pupil of Pischel in Halle where he took his D.Phil. in 1893.

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: He served as Assistant Librarian in the Royal Library at Berlin from 1894 to 1896.

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: From 1896 to 1899 he was Lecturer and Assistant Professor in Christiania.

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: He collaborated with Grierson from 1900 to 1903 in the editing of the volumes of the Linguistic Survey of India.

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: he returned to Oslo where he became Professor of Indian Philology and continued there till his death

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: except from 1914 to 1919 when he served as Professor at Hamburg

relations.subject: Sten Konow
relations.evidence: and in 1924-25 when he was a Visiting Professor at Santineketan.
